final: WITH regional_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client c JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), total_rows AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_clients FROM regional_counts), shares AS (SELECT r.region, r.client_count * 1.0 / t.total_clients AS share FROM regional_counts r JOIN total_rows t ON 1 = 1), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.region, r.client_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS difference FROM shares s JOIN regional_counts r ON r.region = s.region JOIN avg_share a ON 1 = 1 WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(client_count), AVG(share), AVG(difference) FROM kept
